messages:
anika: Hey infra team :wave: — we're onboarding a large retail partner and need to provision a new Dedicated GPU pool in ap-southeast-2 (Sydney). Before I open cloud support tickets, want to align on exact quota/limit increases and capacity plan. High level asks below, can someone own filing the tickets?

anika: Requirements: 
- 40 x p4d.24xlarge (A100) capacity reserved for Dedicated pool (baseline).
- Burst capacity: ability to scale to 80 instances for 2 hour daily windows for peak inference.
- Increase EC2 Spot fallback limits and increase ENI / Elastic IP quotas: +200 ENIs, +50 EIPs.
- VPC peering / cross-account VPC setup between customer VPC and our Dedicated infra VPC (need peering and routes created, plus 2x /24 subnets reserved).
- Increase Service Quotas for EBS gp3 throughput to support high-concurrency model loads.

anika: Quick notes on why: partner traffic forecast (week 1): 1.2M requests/day, avg 18 tokens/request. We expect steady usage plus marketing spikes. Need 20% headroom on baseline and 2x burst.

kevin: @anika I can file AWS and Azure tickets. Do we prefer Reserved Instances/Capacity Reservations or Savings Plans for this? Cost will be material.

anika: Prefer Reserved Capacity (monthly committed) for predictable throughput; finance wants a 12-month commit if we can. Claire, any objections on committing?

claire: We need a cost estimate first. Ballpark: p4d.24xlarge on-demand in ap-southeast-2 is ~ $32/hr (example). For 40 reserved that’s ~ $32 * 24 * 30 * 40 = ~$921,600/mo on-demand; with 1-yr reserved we can expect ~40-50% discount. Still large — need partner to commit to minimum spend. Also include networking and storage in forecast.

maria: From infra-side: AWS quota process for p4d in ap-southeast-2 usually takes 48-72h for region increases but for large counts they'll ask for justification. We'll need an architecture diagram and traffic projections. I can draft the justification.

dave: Operational ask: set autoscaling policy to keep 20% idle headroom (i.e., maintain 48 instances available if baseline 40), and allow the 2x burst window via a manual scale-up or scheduled policy. Also recommend pre-warming ENIs and pre-attaching EBS volumes to avoid cold-start latency.

anika: Good call. For the support tickets we should include: 
```
- Customer: Retail Co (redwood-partner-rtl)
- Use case: low-latency inference for checkout recommendations
- Requested region: ap-southeast-2
- Instance family: p4d (A100) — initial 40, increase to 80 for burst
- Network: +200 ENIs, +50 EIPs, 2 x /24 subnets reserved for peering
- Storage: EBS gp3 throughput limit increase to 20k IOPS aggregate
- Timeline: need baseline by 2026-05-01, burst support by 2026-05-15
- Business justification: production SLA 99.9%, predictable latency, partner commercial commitment attached
```

kevin: Filing AWS case now (I'll paste case IDs). Also opening a ticket with APAC account team to request expedited capacity.

infra-bot: [support-case-created] AWS case #1234567890 opened for EC2 quota increase (p4d) — expected initial response in 12h.

kevin: AWS case #1234567890 : added detailed traffic projections and architecture diagram (uploaded). Also created case #1234567891 for ENI/EIP increases and #1234567892 for EBS throughput.

maria: I'll prepare the VPC peering runbook and a Terraform module for cross-account routes. Putting a PR up to infra repo with a template VPC peer request and subnet allocations.

dave: For capacity planning: let's model cost with two scenarios: conservative (baseline 40 reserved + 20% headroom) and aggressive (baseline 40 reserved + 40 burstable to 80 with spot fallback). I'll run sims on expected token throughput and attach to the ticket.

claire: Finance: mark provisional approval for 12-month commit subject to partner contract. Need finalized estimates by EOD Friday.

anika: Thanks everyone. Action items: 
- @kevin: follow AWS tickets and post case IDs (owned).
- @maria: draft justification and Terraform peer module (owned).
- @dave: capacity sims and autoscaler policy config (owned).
- @claire: prepare provisional budget approval and pricing sensitivity (owned).

anika: Let's reconvene in #eng-infra tomorrow 10am AEST to review ticket progress and finalize numbers. :+1:

kevin: Noted — will update thread as case statuses change.

infra-bot: [support-case-update] AWS case #1234567890 moved to "awaiting capacity confirmation" by platform team.

maria: PR created: infra/terraform#542 — includes VPC peering template, subnet allocations, and IAM role for peering from partner account. Link: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/terraform/pull/542

dave: Draft autoscaler policy (snippet) — keep min = 32, desired = 48, max = 160 (for controlled bursts). Will add to PR later.

anika: Great progress — please keep thread updates short. If anyone needs me to escalate to APAC cloud reps, ping me directly.
